title: Persistent Variable Read
text: Read persistent variable value from target computer, 1 output, {Variable name} sets Name of persistent variable; {Default value} sets the starting value of persistent variable when variable does not exist on target. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Data
ports.summary: Persistent variable output data variable data

params.name: Variable name
params.values: Name of persistent variable Variable1 (default) | character vector | string

params.name: Default value
params.values: Starting value of persistent variable when variable does not exist on target computer 0 (default) | supports same data types as Data port
